siteManifest: Presentation, product ordering, navigation, website-only evidence wording and legacy presentation labels. Canonical identity/status/channel/artifact/qualification/withdrawal values are removed and derived from the shared projection.
activation: Explicit -SharedReleaseTruthPreview only. Alternate manifest/state transports are refused in this mode. Default build and production deploy refuse this candidate.
output: Existing /proof/index.json, /truth/index.json and /truth/products/*.json keep their release facts; provenance names release-truth.json and PREVIEW_ONLY. /shared-release-truth/website.json exposes the exact deterministic projection with channel scopes intact.

Proof registry uses additive schemaVersion 1.1.0 for its source provenance annotation
generatedFrom and generated-file source comments identify release-truth.json
source identity binds the website candidate commit/tree/timestamp; releaseFactsSource binds the canonical App commit and model/projection digests

human truth/proof pages identify the preview-only release authority

currentProductionAuthority: Shipped site-manifest.json at the Proof Ledger release remains authoritative; the dirty active Reality Gate site checkout is not production authority.
